bootstrap.record_read_when: Conflict, supersession, provenance, priority, or an owner transition could decide the task.

controls.select_when: Module/actor identity, autonomy, typed relations, actor information/authority, mechanism/outcome distinctions, or state transitions materially affect the task.
Coherence, institutions, world/system interfaces, feedback, or temporal change materially affect the task; not a sufficiently sourced lookup alone.
Actor receipt, understanding, trust, appraisal, or updates from signals, orders, briefings, or information materially affect the answer.
Mission feasibility, routes/access, execution, capture/escape/pursuit/competition, or persistent loss materially affect the answer.

policies.routing: CI requires Router entry before work dependent on current C2 state. Before the gates, identify only operation/scope, needed sources/controls, evidence, and canon-change permission; do not adopt unread canon premises or derive dependent conclusions. Runtime does not discover, select, load, validate, or confirm the active CI. CI/Router compatibility is pre-runtime maintenance. Re-route materially expanded scope.
policies.discovery: Read 00/05 FULL_FILE from the same current generation. Catalogs navigate; they grant no canon authority, admission, or dependency. Do not presume complete backend enumeration. With a stale catalog, bounded work requires independently identified authoritative owners read FULL_FILE and sufficient for that task; otherwise block. No package-completeness claim without sufficient discovery. New inputs remain UNCONFIRMED.
policies.module_gate: Establish identity, role, admission, scope, and authority before use. CURRENT_SOURCE, headers, catalogs, and Module IDs do not accept assertions. Resolve material overlapping authority through full owner reads and reconciliation; unresolved ownership blocks dependent conclusions. Module IDs remain stable across rename/renumber and are not derived from filenames. Documents are not ontology.
policies.loading: The baseline admits FULL_FILE only for relevant controlling sources, 00/05, and 04 when material. Snippets, search hits, headers, summaries, and Memory do not prove a full read. Do not load all sources or every actor in a team. NODE_OR_FULL, MODULE_REQUIRES, and NODE_REQUIRES are outside the current source contract. Cross-references are not dependencies.
policies.authority: The latest explicit author decision controls only its stated scope, then accepted current owners, then older facts explicitly preserved. Recency, metadata, and repetition grant no priority. Retain UNKNOWN/OPEN/DEFERRED/CONFLICTED and viable alternatives; absence is neither false nor resolved. Questions, proposals, and simulations do not mutate canon. History, rejected/superseded material, and archives are provenance or explicitly requested comparison only, never fallback. Do not use withdrawn premises to invent replacement consequences.
policies.provenance: 07 owns origin/certainty, 06 current premise, and 04 acceptance/reconciliation decisions. Remembered, later-added, and uncertain-memory labels do not automatically confer CURRENT status; combine origin/certainty and acceptance labels only with support. Do not assign assertion-level provenance not supplied by the author.
policies.access: Current C2 sources in Project Sources/Library require confirmed identity and scope. Identically named external material gains no automatic authority. Repository maintenance access is distinct from permission to use lore and proves no live installation. Never claim an unobserved retrieval.
policies.overlays: After source loading and reconciliation, select families by semantic materiality and explicitly active paths. Read selected controls FULL_FILE and transitively expand required and actually satisfied conditional dependencies. A decisive unresolved applicability condition requires review/blocking, not an assumed false value. Do not load all families. Active local paths do not prove live deployment. Missing/ambiguous required controls block only dependent work. No overlay executes during PROMPT_ROUTE_ONLY or changes source authority/truth status or chooses actor outcomes. Expose material control conflicts rather than silently merging them.
policies.carryover: World sources own persistent objective truth/state; briefcases own mission information/beliefs supplied by Rongo; scenarios, when created, own event/branch state. Only author-accepted consequences update each actual affected owner within scope/time, with decisions in 04 and open state in 05. Do not reset worlds, characters, or losses, or automatically synchronize knowledge. Holder/user is not definition owner.
policies.coverage: Before execution and response, recheck route, owners/premises, actual reads, reconciliation/open state, applicable controls, and material gaps. Block only dependent conclusions. PARTIAL requires a named secondary gap demonstrably unable to change the bounded result; relabeling scope cannot bypass decisive missing evidence. Static checks prove neither semantic compliance nor live GPT Project behavior. Stop at task-local closure, not a complete graph.
